svg.aria-label: make run: Builds the app, quits it if it is open, and opens the new one.; make demo: Builds without a certificate and opens the demo with made-up data.; make check: Runs the whole check chain, exactly as on GitHub.; make test: Runs only the tests.; make build: Builds the app and draws its icon.; make restart: Quits the app if it is open and opens it again, without building.; make format: Puts all Swift files into the shared layout.; make coverage: Shows how much of the code the tests reach, per folder.; make snapshots: Optional: photographs every page in demo mode, light and dark, and compares.; make hooks: Optional: runs the check chain before every git push.; make selftest: Measures real folders as the built app and compares with du.; make stress: Opens a second app that clicks through all pages as fast as it can.; make banner: Draws a banner for a guide; asks for its texts.; make pictures: Draws the guides' pictures from docs/pictures, light and dark.; make identity: Creates your own certificate once, in a keychain of its own.; make release: Creates the DMG to pass on, in the dist folder.; make clean: Deletes everything the build produces.
